provenance.notes: A 4-batch, 68-token sparse-attention prompt (not a multiple of the 64-token block size) with 32 query heads grouped 4:1 over 8 key/value heads, head width 128.
The two-layout CSR example from the ONNX Runtime operator documentation, using separate Q/K/V tensors.
Packed [Q|K|V] form of the documented two-layout prompt case.
Full-width NeoX rotary with the minimum accepted head width; rotary_interleaved values other than 1 retain the NeoX layout.
Packed QKV with interleaved rotary over the first 16 of 32 head channels; ONNX Runtime copies the remainder through.
Two decode rows with different history lengths, so the scalar maximum and per-row key lengths have distinct jobs.
Packed decode with full-width NeoX rotary at each row's absolute position.
Eight new tokens over 24 cached tokens, covering the non-prompt sequence_length > 1 path.
A 64-token prompt reaches every documented block row while four query heads share each KV head.
Block size 32 and head width 16 exercise independent key-tile and output-channel tails.
Explicit non-default score scale.
Meaningful float16 prompt; scores and online-softmax accumulators remain float32.
Float16 packed decode with partial NeoX rotary and unequal per-batch history lengths.
ORT classifies a layout from its final CSR count. Once dense, repeated non-prefix column contents are ignored.
A sparse row repeats block 0. CSR encodes a boolean mask, so the duplicate must not duplicate probability mass.
Pinned all-masked-row behavior from ORT's lowest-sentinel softmax: one causal key yields its value, not zero. Also covers scalar total_sequence_length and a zero-width column tensor.
The CPU kernel enables do_rotary only for the exact integer value 1. Otherwise optional rotary inputs are ignored and need not be paired.
ONNX Runtime accepts zero-width paired caches with do_rotary=1; the resulting zero-dimensional rotary transform copies Q and K through.
Prefill shape on the subgroup-matrix route: 64-token blocks, a duplicate CSR column whose repeated block must not repeat its mass, a dense-by-count row, and an off-diagonal-only row.
Packed [Q|K|V] prefill checks that layout 0 ignores dense-row column values while layout 1 retains a gapped sparse row.
Grouped-query prefill with partial NeoX rotary on the subgroup-matrix route; the attention pass reads the rotated-Q intermediate.
A packed [Q|K|V] prefill with 2 query and 2 key/value heads at head width 32, full interleaved rotary embedding (rotary dimension equal to head width), and 64-token sparse blocks.
A 100-token prefill leaves the second query tile 36 rows live, exercising the staged-Q zero padding and guarded stores; the explicit scale attribute overrides the head-size default.
128-token sparse blocks decompose into two 64-key tiles per block at head_size 128, the flagship geometry; the second mask row skips block 0 so its diagonal block carries the ragged causal edge.

A chunked sparse-attention prefill with 2 batches: past lengths of 100 and 68 tokens (each not a multiple of the 64-token block size) precede a shared 64-token query chunk. 2 query and 2 key/value heads, head width 64.
The second block row of the mask is empty, so its 64 queries follow ONNX Runtime's all-masked behavior and return the uniform average of the values in their causal history.
